block.none: Nothing here yet — requests · progress show up once work starts
history.empty: Nothing archived yet. Press [Archive] on a done card to bring it here.
m.hist.noTime: None of the {n} done items has a known duration.
m.hist.none: No work finished in the selected period.
m.hist.aria: Done items and share by duration
m.hist.note: First record → first merge (or done mark). Shares are based on {known} done items with a known time · {missing} without a time are left out. 0s counts as under 1h.
m.states.none: No work recorded in the selected period.
m.states.aria: Current status of {n} items recorded in the selected period
m.states.total: {n} total · {waiting} requests waiting for an answer
m.verify.none: No check runs in the selected period.
m.verify.noPrev: No checks in the previous period
m.trend.aria: Done items per date range · selected period vs. previous period
m.trend.none: Not enough records in the selected period to show the trend.
m.trend.note: First and last day cover the selected hours only. Long periods are grouped into up to 14 date ranges. The vertical axis is done count.
m.stage.note: Per-stage values for done items. Each stage covers a different number of items, so they don't add up to the total time.
m.count.noPrev: No done items in the previous period
m.kpi.leadBasis: First record → first merge. Up to the done mark if nothing merged.
m.kpi.prBasis: PR opened → merged. Per PR merged in the selected period · matched by repo+pr.
m.kpi.prCounts: Counted {count} / merged {had} · open time unknown {missingOpen} · time reversed {invalidOrder} · opened in period with no merge {unmerged}
m.kpi.verifyBasis: Total check time per done item · includes run time and queueing.
m.kpi.reviewBasis: Total review start → conclusion time per done item · not an average per run.
m.stagesNote: Review · checks add up from the start of a done item to its first merge (or done mark). Overlaps count once and are split in the order checks → review → waiting to merge → waiting for answer → work. Items without a stage and records without a time are left out of that average. PR time overlaps these ranges, so it isn't added.
m.panel.histNote: Done items by duration · shares based on items with a time
m.panel.statesNote: Current status of items recorded in the selected period
m.panel.verifyNote: Checks run in the selected period · passed/failed/unknown
m.panel.trendNote: By first merge · done mark if nothing merged
m.panel.stagesNote: Bar = average · thin line end = p75
m.empty: No work records yet. Done trend and durations show up once records build up.
m.t.leadSub: Merged {merged} · by done {doneOnly} · left out, no start {noStart}
m.moreNumbers: Show details — checks, questions and more
m.plansNote: Total: first record → first merge (or done mark). Stage times split this range and differ from actual session time. None means no record for that stage; time unknown means the duration can't be determined.
m.legendNote: Bars show known ranges only · if all are unknown, one bar for the whole duration
m.since: Records since {date} · status changes are recorded only while the worklist is running
m.workNote: Period total · work runs in parallel so this can exceed elapsed time · {linked} sessions · left out: review {reviewer}, no plan mark {unlinked} · Claude {claude} · Codex {codex}
